verdict.rationale: Box documents read-only shared links for folders with configurable access levels, role-based collaborations on folders, and an event feed plus download webhooks that show who accessed content. A community user also confirms selectively granting outside parties access to files and folders. However, nothing in the evidence documents download restrictions (e.g., disabling downloads on a link), and access visibility is shown mainly through developer APIs rather than a founder-facing access report. missing for 10: documented download controls/disable-download option, a user-facing access/activity report for diligence viewers, link expiration/password evidence for shared folders, hands-on data-room corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can run a lightweight data room — organized shared folders with view-only links, download controls, and access visibility for diligence

citations.quote: Shared links are URLs that are generated for files, folders, web links stored in Box, which provide direct, read-only access to the resource.
Generate URL-based access to files, folders, and web links stored in Box with configurable access levels.
Collaborations define access permissions for users and groups on files and folders, similar to access control lists.
Create a V2 webhook that notifies your endpoint when a file is downloaded
The event feed provides a way for an application to subscribe to any actions performed by any user, users, or service in an enterprise.
it's possible to selectively grant outside parties access to files/folders.
